hypothesis: candidate_pool: Form 4 footnotes that disclose multi-year executive equity vesting with retained ownership may identify aligned leadership and constrained future supply better than raw A/M/S/F transaction-code context.

nearest.reopen_condition: A retry needs materially new PIT evidence, such as forward daily replacement value on sale clusters, explicit post-sale ownership-retention context, or a shared default-off daily Form 4 sale-absorption adapter with non-replay observations. Pure threshold, role, 10b5-1, or liquidity retunes stay frozen.

A retry needs materially new PIT evidence beyond raw Form 4 exercise-and-hold rows, such as closed daily forward replacement-value observations from a shared default-off adapter, parsed executive compensation/holdings context, or relation evidence that the exercise-retention source conflicts with accepted source candidates. Pure threshold, role, 10b5-1, option-exercise, or liquidity retunes stay f

A retry needs materially new PIT evidence beyond retained ownership, such as daily forward replacement value for sale clusters, parsed Form 144 float/sale-plan context, or a shared default-off daily Form 4 sale-retention adapter with closed forward observations. Pure threshold, role, 10b5-1, or liquidity retunes stay frozen.

A valid retry needs materially new PIT evidence beyond raw C-code rows, such as parsed conversion purpose/lockup or selling-plan context, forward daily replacement observations from a shared default-off adapter, or 13D/13G holder-intent evidence that distinguishes control-holder supply relief from routine class conversion mechanics.

novelty.new_evidence_axis: Parsed Form 4 footnote multi-year vesting/retention horizon and grant-retained ownership ratio, not transaction-code A/M/S/F thresholds, 10b5-1 handling, owner-role filters, or SBC-context scalars.

prediction.confidence_reason: Prior Form 4 compensation-context tests failed when they only used transaction-code context. This tests a materially different provenance field, the disclosed multi-year vesting/retention horizon in Form 4 footnotes, but risk remains high because many grants are routine compensation rather than demand.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $25M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing Form 4 usable_trade_date, missing multi-year vesting footnote, same-accession open-market sale, insufficient retained ownership, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper parses the same Form 4 footnotes, multi-year vesting horizon, same-accession sale exclusion, retained ownership ratio, price confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The Form 4 multi-year equity-retention source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, fewer_than_two_ev_improved_windows, target_sample_too_small, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). It is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.0124; aggregate PnL delta $+729.85; max drawdown drift +0.0000; 18 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping Form 4 A/M/S/F code lists, owner roles, 10b5-1 handling, vesting-year threshold, retained-ratio threshold, grant-share threshold, RS/close/volume/vol guards, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs materially richer executive-compensation provenance, such as grant fair value from proxy data, vesting/lockup terms tied to actual retention outcomes, executive ownership percentage, or closed forward replacement-value rows from a shared daily Form 4 retention helper. Do not sweep Form 4 transaction-code lists, role filters, 10b5-1 handling, vesting-year threshold, RS/close/volume guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
